verdict.rationale: The product is API-first, so it can be driven programmatically without a UI. It exposes REST endpoints with separate test and production hosts (POST /acp/v1/tokens, /instructions, /credentials), a free sandbox for test transactions, and an MCP server/toolkit published on npm that scripts can call. Core flows still require a human: card enrollment returns PENDING until the cardholder completes OTP or passkey step-up, and each payment instruction must be passkey-authenticated by the user, so end-to-end unattended automation is limited. Missing for 10: documented CI/headless test-mode guidance, a way to bypass or simulate the passkey/OTP step-up in sandbox, a CLI, and hands-on corroboration of automated runs.
